projects.title: ZEX Rates Aggregator
projects.description: Courier rate management platform for ZEX International. Parses 17+ proprietary carrier Excel formats (DHL, Aramex, UPS, APX) into a unified database and delivers instant price comparisons with automatic markup. Three user roles across web (admin + client portals) and a production Android app.
projects.longDescription:
ZEX Rates is a full-stack, multi-platform courier rate management and quote comparison system built for ZEX International, a freight and logistics company.

The Problem It Solves
Freight agents receive rate sheets from each courier as Excel files — all structured differently. To quote a shipment, an agent would open multiple spreadsheets, manually find the destination, look up weight brackets, apply markup, and repeat for every carrier. Error-prone and time-consuming.

ZEX Rates automates the entire pipeline — from raw Excel upload to instant quote delivery — across web and mobile.

Key Technical Challenges

1. Excel Parsing Engine
Built a type-detection system that identifies 17+ distinct carrier file formats (Aramex flat grid, DHL/UPS dual-sheet zone system, APX regional variants, etc.) and normalises all data into a single schema: (country, country_code, weight_kg, price, zone, rate_type). Special handling for 4,813 Australian postcodes mapped to carrier zones.

2. Rate Calculation Engine
Given a destination, service type, and weight, the engine finds active carrier files, resolves the correct pricing strategy (direct, zone-based, or single-destination), applies the admin-set global markup, and returns results sorted by price.

3. Multi-Role, Multi-Platform Access
Three user roles (admin, agent, client) across four surfaces — admin web, client web, Android mobile, and the API. Clients see anonymised 'Option 1, Option 2' results. Agents and admins see real provider names. Role enforcement at both API middleware and database (Supabase RLS) layers.

Deployment Architecture
- Backend API: FastAPI on HuggingFace Spaces (Docker, port 7860)
- Admin Web: Vercel → admin.zexintl.com
- Client Web: Vercel → rates.zexintl.com
- Mobile: React Native + Expo → production APK via EAS
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS + Auth)

Scale
- 5 deployable components
- 17+ Excel format parsers
- 40+ REST API endpoints
- 8 database tables with relational constraints
- 4,813 Australian postcodes mapped to carrier zones
- 3 user roles across 4 platforms
- Production Android APK in active use

projects.title: Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Textbook
projects.description: AI-powered interactive textbook for Physical AI and humanoid robotics education. Features a RAG chatbot built on OpenAI embeddings and Qdrant vector search for context-aware question answering across textbook content. Covers ROS 2, humanoid robotics, and Vision-Language-Action systems. Built during a hackathon.
projects.longDescription:
Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Textbook is a hackathon project that addresses a real gap in robotics education: complex topics like ROS 2, humanoid robotics, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are scattered across academic papers, documentation, and courses — hard to navigate and even harder to query interactively.

The platform provides a structured digital textbook with an AI-powered RAG chatbot that lets users ask natural language questions and receive context-aware answers drawn from the actual textbook content.

How It Works
Textbook content is chunked and embedded using OpenAI embedding models, then stored in a Qdrant vector database. When a user asks a question, the system performs semantic search to retrieve the most relevant content chunks, which are then passed to the LLM as context for the response. This keeps answers grounded in the textbook rather than hallucinated.

Tech Breakdown
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Docusaurus for clean documentation-style content presentation
- Backend: FastAPI handling auth, user preferences, and AI query routing
- Vector DB: Qdrant for semantic search and embedding storage
- AI: OpenAI API for embeddings and chat completions
- Infrastructure: Docker + GitHub Actions + Neon Postgres

Features
- Context-aware RAG chatbot
- Multilingual translation support
- Personalised learning preferences
- Fully responsive for desktop and mobile

projects.title: Tere Ride Sharing
projects.description: Ride-sharing web application connecting passengers with nearby drivers in real time. Features user registration, ride booking with fare estimation, driver matching, and trip status management. Built with a full MERN stack, Socket.io for real-time updates, and Google Maps API for location services.
projects.longDescription:
Tere Ride Sharing is a full-stack ride-sharing platform built for the Nigerian urban transport market. It solves the core logistics problem of connecting passengers with available drivers efficiently, without the overhead of a native mobile app.

The platform covers the complete ride lifecycle:
- Passenger registers and books a ride by location and destination
- System estimates fare and matches available drivers nearby
- Driver accepts the request and manages trip status from pickup to drop-off
- Both parties see live status updates via Socket.io

Tech Breakdown
- Frontend: React.js with Tailwind CSS — responsive, works on mobile browsers
- Backend: Node.js + Express.js REST API
- Real-time: Socket.io for live ride status updates
- Database: MongoDB (primary) + MySQL
- Maps: Google Maps API for location and routing
- Auth: JWT-based authentication
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render/AWS (backend)

This project demonstrates end-to-end full-stack development — from database design and API architecture to real-time communication and cloud deployment.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio & CV Builder
projects.description: Production portfolio with a built-in admin CMS and a 12-format CV generator. All content is managed via a password-protected admin panel — no external CMS required. GitHub-synced data persistence keeps the Vercel deployment always up to date.
projects.longDescription:
A production-ready personal portfolio built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS 4, featuring a complete content management system accessible via a password-protected admin panel.

The Problem It Solves
Most portfolios are either static (hard to update) or tied to an external CMS (paid, with lock-in). This system stores all data in a flat JSON file, syncs changes to GitHub via API on every admin save, which triggers a Vercel redeploy — so the live site always reflects the latest content without touching code.

Key Features
- Admin CMS with sections for every portfolio category (projects, experience, skills, services, testimonials, certifications)
- Multi-format CV generator producing 12 region-specific PDF resumes: Gulf, Saudi, Emirati, Europass, USA, Canada, Pakistan/India, UK, Australia/NZ, Lebenslauf (EN/DE), Academic
- Email CV sharing — sends the generated PDF as an attachment via Gmail SMTP (Nodemailer)
- Project media — screenshot capture from demo URLs or manual image/video upload, saved to GitHub
- GitHub auto-sync — every admin save commits the JSON data file to GitHub via the API
- Light/Dark mode toggle with 6 colour themes
- Command palette (⌘K) for quick navigation

Tech Breakdown
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion
- CV Generation: jsPDF with custom templates per region
- Email: Nodemailer + Gmail SMTP
- Persistence: GitHub Contents API for file sync
- Auth: SHA-256 hashed session cookie (edge-compatible)
- Deployment: Vercel

projects.title: Ishrat Enterprises
projects.description: First paid client project — a professional business portfolio and company showcase website. Responsive, SEO-friendly site with animated sections covering company services, portfolio, and contact information. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
projects.longDescription:
Ishrat Enterprises is a professional business portfolio website — the first paid client project delivered in 2024.

The client needed a clean, modern digital presence to showcase their company services and portfolio to potential business clients. Key requirements were fast load times, mobile responsiveness, and a professional look that could stand alongside larger competitors.

What Was Built
- Multi-section landing page: hero, services, portfolio, about, and contact
- Smooth scroll animations using Framer Motion
- Fully responsive layout optimised for mobile, tablet, and desktop
- SEO-friendly structure with proper meta tags and semantic HTML
- Contact form integration
- Deployed to Vercel with a custom domain

Tech Breakdown
- Framework: Next.js + React.js
- Styling: TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Animations: Framer Motion
- Deployment: Vercel
